description: Open interest of one perpetual-futures symbol on each venue Vike polls: aster, binance, bitget, bybit, hyperliquid, kucoin, okx. `oi_usd` is USD NOTIONAL (open contracts x mark price when polled), not contracts or coins. Without `hours`: the newest print per venue and its age in seconds; `venues` printed within the last hour, `stale_venues` went silent (last print within 30 days) and must NOT be summed in. With `hours` (1-168): an hourly series per venue, the last print in each UTC hour. Venues are polled roughly every 5-8 minutes. `symbol` is the canonical base asset ('BTC', not 'BTCUSDT'). A symbol no venue lists returns empty lists and a note, never zeros.

exchange.description: Only this venue (lower case), e.g. 'binance'. Omit for every venue.

hours.description: Omit for the latest print per venue. 1 to 168 for an hourly series over that many hours.
